review_notes: I read the whole file. I compared its declarations with the nearest existing concepts. `MvFunctor` is a multivariate functor on `TypeVec n → Type`. It is not the same concept as core `Functor`, which has a single `Type → Type` argument, or as `CategoryTheory.Functor`. `LiftP`, `LiftR` and `supp` are the multivariate analogues of `Functor.Liftp`, `Functor.Liftr` and `Functor.supp` in Mathlib/Control/Functor.lean. They are over `TypeVec` and are not duplicates. `LiftP'` and `LiftR'` are arrow-style variants of `LiftP` and `LiftR`. They are tied to those definitions by `LiftP_def` and `LiftR_def`, and they serve a documented purpose, so I do not count them as competing versions. `MvFunctor.ofEquiv` is a functor transport along an equivalence. `MvQPF.ofEquiv` in Mathlib/Data/QPF/Multivariate/Basic.lean builds on it: it takes a separate `map_eq` hypothesis and constructs a QPF. I did not find a competing independent definition of an existing Mathlib concept, so I abstain. One uncertainty: I did not search for other `TypeVec`-based functor encodings outside the paths I looked at.
